russh: Unbounded memory allocation in agent protocol server via crafted constraint records
items.summary: ### Summary `russh_keys::agent::server::add_key` (`russh/src/keys/agent/server.rs:271-319`) spawns a dedicated tokio task for every 5-byte `SSH_AGENT_CONSTRAIN_LIFETIME` record attached to an added key, each cloning the key blob and sleeping for the declared lifetime (up to ~136 years). The loop has no per-request task budget, and spawned tasks are not rolled back when the overall request fails. items.summary: ## Summary The Fortran extractor's C-preprocessor step (`graphify/extractors/fortran.py`, `_cpp_preprocess`) applies an incomplete `#include` hardening. items.title: LoopX serve-status permissive CORS policy exposes control-plane state and private Markdown files
items.summary: ## Summary `loopx serve-status` sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` on **every** response, including its unauthenticated `GET` routes. Because the endpoint is unauthenticated and bound to a fixed, well-known loopback port, **any website the operator visits can read LoopX control-plane state and the contents of Markdown files inside every registered goal repo**, using a plain `fetch()` with no user interaction.
